name: Instinct
source:
Milo Stone, a gifted young quarterback at a rising D1 university, has the opportunity of a lifetime: to shine before roaring crowds in his first year.

But after a car accident delays the start of his season, he arrives at Redfield University hoping to make friends, and maybe even find love.

Instead, he’s met with strange sightings and witnesses events he cannot explain. As the semester unfolds, Milo begins to sense that his new life isn't just a clean slate… it holds secrets he was never meant to find.
